update_message: KeyflawX 1.6.0 (Build 43) brings a monochrome white UI redesign with pure white as the default accent and Primary Color settings, replaces layer linking with a spiral pick whip, fixes Motion Blur property distortion and camera cut smearing, fixes layer eye icon selection outlines, and restores full KeyflawX tools with smoother playback.
changelog: Redesigned the interface from pink to monochrome white for a clean, neutral editing workspace
Set pure white (#FFFFFF) as the default accent color across buttons, selection outlines, and active controls
Added Primary Color customization in Settings with an HSV/HSB color picker and built-in presets
Replaced layer linking with an interactive spiral pick whip next to each layer's eye icon when link mode is active
Fixed Motion Blur so it only adjusts blur strength without distorting scale, rotation, 3D orientation, or other layer properties
Fixed layer eye icon outlines so only the selected layer is highlighted
Fixed Motion Blur across camera cuts so layers stay clean without smearing from the previous camera
Restored full KeyflawX tools with smoother playback and rendering performance
